label: Gave it as a gift
quote: Got this for my dad, who has been a car guy his whole life. He read it that afternoon and called to tell me about a car he had before I was born. I thought I’d heard all his stories by now.
name: Sarah M.

label: Shared it with family
quote: My grandpa really enjoyed this. He showed me the car picture and asked if I knew what it was. I had no idea, but of course he knew. We sat and talked about old cars for a while.
name: Jake R.

label: Gave it as a gift
quote: Never know what to get my dad because he says he doesn’t want anything. Took a chance on this and he really liked it. My mom said he’s already read the whole thing.
name: Amy B.

label: Subscriber
quote: I’ve still got a soft spot for the cars I grew up around. Enjoyed the stories, especially the ones about family. Made me wish I had a few pictures of my dad’s old Chevy.
